title: GW layer is wrong
symptom: GW bands are scrambled or bumped after the EXX layer checks out.
evidence_required: PP/NAO/hash identity of the basis set

candidate_experiments.expected_improvement: excludes a shared construction problem first
candidate_experiments.guard: do not change GW-specific parameters while fullcoul is unresolved

candidate_experiments.action: decrease the generation-stage exx_pca_threshold and regenerate the ABFS
candidate_experiments.expected_improvement: enlarges the auxiliary basis and reduces the GW LRI error
candidate_experiments.guard: an oversized auxiliary basis becomes linearly dependent; keep the production value at 10 with ABFS_ORBITAL

candidate_experiments.action: switch to another matched PP/NAO set from the database
candidate_experiments.expected_improvement: removes basis-specific GW sensitivity when the numerical knobs are exhausted
candidate_experiments.guard: keep the PP/NAO pair matched and record the new set ids

stop_condition: GW bands are smooth or the candidate list is exhausted.
